FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Rolling Bearings Sectional Committee had been approved by the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. As per the practice in the Bearing Industry, the manufacturers of plummer blocks are supplying the plummer block housings without the accessories such as felt strips, locknuts, lockwashers and tapered adapter sleeves, etc. Accordingly, this standard has been prepared to cover the present practices in the Industry. The requirements of accessories are covered separately in the respective standards which are given below for information: IS 1719 : 1988 Pressed wool felt (t/lird revision) IS 6731 : 1977 Locknuts, narrow series and lock washers with straight inner tab for rolling bearings Cfirst revision) IS 5656 : 1977 Tapered adaptor sleeves for rolling bearings The plummer block assembly is covered by a separate specification, namely, IS 4773 : 1979 `Plummer blocks for rolling bearings (first revision)' which outlines the quality requirements for plummer blocks. Eventually, it is intended to prepare a composite standard for plummer blocks and various components so that the user is able to refer all the standards in one volume. In the formulation of this standard, assistance has been derived from IS0 113-2 : 1979 `Rolling bearing accessories - Part 2 : Plummer block housings'. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded offin accordance with IS 2 : 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values (~c~ised)`. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

IS No. 5669 : 1987

Title

1.1 This standard specifies boundary dimensions and other requirements for plummer block housings for rolling bearings. 1.1.1 One light series, primarily intended for bcariigs in diameter series 2, and one medium series, primarily intended for bearings in diameter series 3, are specified. The diameter series are covered in IS 5669 : 1987. 2 REFERENCES 2.1 The following standards contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. 4 MATERIAL 4.1 Plummer block housing shall be made from cast iron conforming to at least Grade FG 350 of IS 210 : 1993 or cast steel conforming to IS 1030 : 1989 or spheriodal graphite cast iron conforming to Grade SG 400/15 of IS 1865 : 1991.

6 TOLERANCES 6.1 Unless

9 MARKING 9.1 The plummer block housings shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, trade-mark (if any), and designation,

otherwise specified all dimensional tolerances shall be in accordance with IS 2102 (Part 1) : 1993 for housings made of iron castings and IS 4897 : 1994 for housings made of steel castings. 7 WORKMANSHIP
AND FINIS11 7.1 Plummer block housings shall be well finished and free from burrs, blowholes and other casting defects.

9.2 BIS Certificatibn

Marking

The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark. 9.2.1 The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of Bwenu of Indinn Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
10 PACKING 10.1 The bearing surface of the plummer block housings shall be coated with anti-rust oil or grease before supplying to the user. The housings may be individually packed or packed as desired by the purchaser.

7.2 Outside surface of the plummer block housings may be painted using anti-rust paint as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 8 DESIGNATION by the corresponding bearing diameter series, housing seating diameter and the number ofthis standard. EXlW1pb: A plummer block housing for radial rolling bearing of diameter series 2 having housing seating diameter 80 mm shall be designated as: Plummer block housing 2 CD 80 IS 14347.

Standards are also reviewed periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes areneeded; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision. Users of Indian Standards should ascertain that they are in possession of the latest amendments or edition by referring to the latest issue of `BIS Handbook' and `Standards Monthly Additions'.
